title: 第一百六十七章 黑龙玄铁第一百六十六章 黑市
content_zh:
“骗人？什么骗人呀？”小孩道，“这位公子你若是出不起灵石，就把原石放下吧。”
“就是，你不买别人还要买呢。”
“我看是没灵石，又爱出风头。”
“臭外地的，看他那副穷酸样，囊中羞涩了……”
……
楚天舒在小孩耳边道：“你和你爹一唱一和的把我当猴耍呢？再不卖给我当众揭穿了。”
“你……胡说什么？我不认识那个……”
“你如果真不认识他，那时候是怎么知道他从河底打捞出石头的？”楚天舒道。
小孩一时语塞，他求助似的看了看店老板。肥头大耳的店老板肉眼可见的慌张了。他已经骗了好多人，在这一带信誉几乎等于，正想着开个小号引流，反正最后灵石都是到他兜里。
“难道被他看出来了？”店老板向小孩不断使眼色。小孩不经意间打了个手势，店老板意识到自己被看穿了，连忙咳嗽几声。
小孩心领神会：“行行行拿去吧，给你了。”
楚天舒将六块原石一把抓起，然后丢下了五块灵石。
店老板肺都快气炸了！但他又对楚天舒无可奈何，只能在心中暗骂：“他妈的！穷鬼！最好别让我见到你！”
“唉，他怎么只付了五块灵石啊？不是说好的三十块一颗原石吗？”
“呃……他找我赊账来着，下次再还。”小孩硬着头皮道。
“啊？赊账。不行，他能赊账，那我也要赊。”
“喂小鬼，本大爷也要赊账！”
……
人群乱了起来，小孩也不知所措。这来黑市的人可是一点信誉都没有的，你敢赊账，那就相当于白送人。
“不卖了，不卖了！今天不卖了。”关键时候小孩将原石全部塞到小推车上，随后落荒而逃。

真没招了。
今天倒了个大霉，碰到了楚天舒这个狠角色。左顾右盼，这黑市也没别的东西吸引他了，正当楚天舒要转头离去之时，有人叫住了他。
“前面那位小兄弟，能把你手上的石头给我看看吗？”一位头戴斗笠的女子出声道。
“不卖。”楚天舒理都没理她转头就走。
“我出一万灵石。”斗笠女道。
楚天舒钻入人群当中，眨眼便消失不见。
斗笠女生气的跺了跺脚，她怀中一只金毛铜眼鼠吱吱叫喊，好像在说东西要跑了。
“小金，带路。”斗笠女道。
小老鼠嗅了嗅气味，在斗笠女耳边叽叽喳喳，不知说了些什么。
……
甩开人群，楚天舒正要走回客栈，这个时候他身后又响起了声音：“小兄弟，慢着。”
“跟上来了？”楚天舒脚步一顿。
“此前是我失礼了，但我并没有恶意，只是想要小兄弟手上那几颗石头。”斗笠女道，“这样吧，我出五万，五万灵石是笔不小的价钱了……”
“我说不卖，你是耳朵聋了吗？”楚天舒转头道。
“有话好说嘛，我说了并无恶意。”斗笠女语气变得柔和了一些，尽量让自己看起来比较合适。
“跟了我一路，还说并无恶意？”楚天舒道，“你是谁？谁派你过来的？接近我有什么企图？”
“我……我哪有什么企图啊？也没有什么人派我过来……”斗笠女道，“我真的很想要那几块石头，你就卖给我好不好？”
content_en:
"Liar? What kind of lie?" said the child, "Master, if you can't afford the spiritual stone, just put down the original stone."
"That's right, if you don't buy it, others will buy it."
"I don't think he has a spiritual stone, and he likes to be pushy."
"That stinky guy from out of town, look at how poor he is, he's so strapped for money..."
…
Chu Tianshu said in the child's ear: "You and your father are singing along and playing with me like a monkey? If you don't sell it to me, you will expose it in public."
"What...are you talking nonsense? I don't know that..."
"If you really didn't know him, how did you know that he fished out stones from the bottom of the river?" Chu Tianshu asked.
The child was speechless for a moment and looked at the shop owner as if asking for help. The fat-headed and big-eared shop owner was visibly panicked. He has deceived many people, and his reputation in this area is almost equal. He is thinking of opening a small account to divert traffic. Anyway, in the end the spiritual stones will end up in his pocket.
"Did he see it?" The shop owner kept winking at the child. The child made a gesture inadvertently, and the store owner realized that he had been seen through and coughed several times.
The child understood: "Okay, okay, take it, I'll give it to you."
Chu Tianshu grabbed six rough stones and then dropped five spiritual stones.
The shop owner’s lungs were about to explode! But he had nothing to do with Chu Tianshu, and could only curse in his heart: "Damn! Poor guy! It's best not to let me see you!"
"Hey, why did he only pay five pieces of spiritual stones? Didn't he agree to pay thirty yuan for each rough stone?"
"Uh...he asked me for credit. I'll pay him back next time." The child said bravely.
"Ah? Credit. No, if he can give it on credit, then I will give it on credit too."
"Hey kid, I also want credit!"
…
The crowd was in chaos, and the children were at a loss. The people who come to the black market here have no credibility at all. If you dare to give money on credit, it is equivalent to giving it away for free.
"No more selling, no more selling! No more selling today." At the critical moment, the child stuffed all the rough stones into the cart, and then ran away.
I'm really out of ideas.
I had a bad luck today and met the ruthless character Chu Tianshu. Looking around, there was nothing else in the black market that attracted him. Just when Chu Tianshu was about to turn around and leave, someone stopped him.
"Little brother in front, can you show me the stone in your hand?" A woman wearing a bamboo hat said.
"Not for sale." Chu Tianshu ignored her and turned around to leave.
"I'll give you 10,000 spirit stones," said the woman in a hat.
Chu Tianshu got into the crowd and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
The girl in a bamboo hat stamped her feet angrily, and a golden-haired, copper-eyed mouse in her arms squeaked, as if to say something was about to run away.
"Xiao Jin, lead the way." The woman in a hat said.
The little mouse sniffed the scent and chirped in the ear of the girl in a bamboo hat, not knowing what she said.
…
After getting rid of the crowd, Chu Tianshu was about to walk back to the inn. At this time, another voice came from behind him: "Little brother, wait a minute."
"Following?" Chu Tianshu paused.
"I was rude before, but I didn't mean any harm. I just wanted the few stones in my little brother's hand." The woman in the hat said, "Let's do this. I'll pay fifty thousand. Fifty thousand spiritual stones is a lot of money..."
"I said I won't sell it, are you deaf?" Chu Tianshu turned around and asked.
"It's okay to say something. I didn't mean any harm when I said it." The woman in the hat softened her tone and tried her best to look more appropriate.
"You followed me all the way and you said you didn't mean any harm?" Chu Tianshu said, "Who are you? Who sent you here? What's your intention to get close to me?"
"I...what's my intention? No one sent me here..." the woman in a hat said, "I really want those stones, can you just sell them to me?"
